name: mosga-community-data
description: Community dataset repository scaffold. CI re-scans every incoming record with the PINNED @mosga/sanitizer engine (byte-identical to the contributor's local pre-check), and a canary self-test proves the gate is alive on every run.

scripts.check:compat: npm run validate:manifest && npm run validate:vendor && npm run test:manifest
scripts.check: npm run check:compat && npm run scan:canary

comment: The four @mosga tarballs below are self-contained 0.1.0 development snapshots pinned by package-lock.json. They make a generated repository installable before these packages are published to npm. Replace all four together only in a coordinated engine release so CI remains byte-identical to contributor provenance.
